question: How do I get started?
answer: Getting started is easy! Simply sign up for an account, follow our onboarding guide, and you'll be up and running in minutes. Our getting started tutorial will walk you through the essential features and help you set up your first project.

question: Can I collaborate with my team?
answer: Yes! Our Pro and Enterprise plans include team collaboration features. You can invite team members, assign roles and permissions, share projects, and work together seamlessly on document redaction workflows.
